Returns the authenticated user's profile with route statistics. `/users/profile` is an alias of `/users/me`.

patch.description: Updates profile fields (display name, locale, preferences) on the authenticated user.

delete.description: Initiates self-deletion (ADR 0017). Soft-deletes the user and their routes, revokes all sessions, and schedules permanent erasure 30 days later. The user can cancel by signing back in and calling POST /users/me/cancel-deletion within the grace window.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile with route statistics. `/users/profile` is an alias of `/users/me`.

post.description: Sets a password for the authenticated user, or changes it if one already exists. HIBP/length validation always applies. Changing an existing password requires the current password. Adding a password to a Google-only account does not require email verification (OAuth already proved email control).

400.description: Password failed validation, or current password missing on change

get.description: Returns a ZIP containing routess-export.json (full account dump) and one GPX file per Route. Soft-capped at 1000 routes; accounts above the cap get a 400 and should contact support. GDPR Art. 15 right of access.

post.description: Cancels a self-initiated deletion that's still inside the 30-day grace window. Restores the user's routes and clears the pending status. No-op if the user is not in a pending state.
Authenticates user using a Google OAuth2 authorization code from the popup auth-code flow

Step 1 of email+password signup. Validates the password (length 12-128, HIBP breach check) and emails a verification link. The User row is NOT created until the verification link is clicked. Always returns 200 regardless of whether the email is already registered (no enumeration); existing accounts get a 'you already have an account' email instead of a verification link.

200.description: Request accepted (always 200, even if the email is already registered)

400.description: Invalid password (too short, too long, or breached)

post.description: Step 2: consume the verification token, create the User and password method, and start a session.

409.description: Email was claimed by another signup in the meantime

post.description: Authenticates with email + password. Returns a session JWT. Generic error message on failure.
Always returns 200 to avoid email enumeration. If a user with this email and a password method exists, a reset email is sent.
Consumes a reset token, sets a new password, and revokes ALL sessions for the user.

400.description: Token invalid or expired, or password failed validation

get.description: Returns all active sessions for the authenticated user. The session that issued the current JWT is marked with isCurrent=true.

delete.description: Revokes the given session for the authenticated user. The current session cannot be revoked here; use POST /auth/logout for that.

post.description: Revokes every active session for the authenticated user, including the current one.

Creates a new PAT for the authenticated user. Returns the plaintext exactly once; it is hashed at rest and cannot be retrieved again. Tokens authenticate non-browser clients (CLI, AI agents, scripts) via `Authorization: Bearer routess_pat_…`. Minting is cookie-only: PATs cannot mint other PATs. PATs are blocked from `/v1/admin/*` and from `DELETE /v1/users/me` regardless of the owner's role.

get.description: Lists the authenticated user's active (non-revoked) PATs. Plaintext is never returned; only metadata. PAT callers need `read` scope.

delete.description: Revokes the token with the given ID. Idempotent: revoking an already-revoked token succeeds. PAT callers need `write` scope; revoking the token that authenticates the request itself additionally requires X-Routess-Confirm: true, since it locks the caller out.

parameters.name: X-Routess-Confirm
parameters.description: Required as `true` when a PAT revokes itself. Cookie sessions ignore this header.

428.description: PAT-authenticated self-revocation without `X-Routess-Confirm: true`. Surface the `impact` field to the user and retry with the header set.

post.description: Creates a new route for the authenticated user. PAT callers need `write` scope (#170) and must set X-Routess-Confirm: true when creating with `visibility: public`, mirroring the PATCH gate.

parameters.name: X-Routess-Confirm
parameters.description: Set to `true` when a PAT call creates a route with `visibility: public`. Cookie sessions ignore this header.

428.description: PAT-authenticated create with `visibility: public` without `X-Routess-Confirm: true`. Surface the `impact` field to the user and retry with the header set.

get.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's routes (any visibility), newest first. Paginated via `limit` and `offset`; the total number of routes is returned in the `X-Total-Count` response header.

200.description: Routes retrieved successfully. X-Total-Count carries the total route count.

get.description: Returns public Routes that clear the Indexable quality gate (see CONTEXT.md), newest-updated first. Anonymous; feeds the landing sitemap and discovery surfaces. Total count in X-Total-Count.
Returns the public Routes owned by the given user. Excludes private and unlisted routes.

Returns the route as a GPX 1.1 document with a routess-namespaced extension carrying per-waypoint Type. `ref` is a numeric route ID (owner: any visibility; non-owners: public only) or a 32-hex share token (public and unlisted). Private routes return 404 to non-owners. Owners authenticate with a cookie session or any PAT. Unlisted responses carry X-Robots-Tag: noindex.

404.description: Route not found or not viewable

get.description: Returns the route. `ref` is either a numeric route ID (owners see any visibility; non-owners only public, so sequential IDs can't be walked to discover unlisted routes) or a 32-hex share token (serves public and unlisted to anyone with the link). Private routes return 404 to non-owners. Owners authenticate with a cookie session or any PAT.

PAT-auth.description: Personal access token for non-browser clients. Mint at Settings → API Tokens. Carries one of two scopes: `read` (list/get Routes, export GPX, profile) or `write` (`read` plus metadata-only mutations on owned routes and on preferences). Blocked from /admin/* and from DELETE /users/me. Destructive operations require `X-Routess-Confirm: true` and return 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED otherwise. See ADR-0022 and ADR-0023.

handle.description: Public address of the user's Profile (see CONTEXT.md 'Handle').

idHash.description: Pseudonymous user identifier for client-side ProductEvent tracking. See ADR-0020.

deletionStatus.description: Deletion lifecycle. 'pending_hard_delete' means the user has requested self-deletion and is in the 30-day grace window before permanent erasure. The web app should redirect such users to a cancel screen.

deletionRequestedAt.description: When self-deletion was requested. Hard-delete fires 30 days after this timestamp.

hasPassword.description: Whether the user has an active email/password credential. Drives password-change UI affordances.

handle.description: New Handle for the user's Profile. Lowercase alphanumeric plus hyphen, 3-30 chars. Old profile URLs 404 after a change; the freed handle returns to the pool.

avatar.description: Avatar image URL. Must be https: clients render it, so no other schemes are accepted.

currentPassword.description: Required if changing an existing password.

code.description: Google OAuth2 authorization code from the popup auth-code flow

isCurrent.description: True for the session that issued the JWT on this request. Cannot be revoked from the list.

label.description: Human-readable label so the user can identify the token later in the Settings list. Not displayed to anyone but the owning user.

scope.description: Scope of the token. `read` covers list/get/export and reading the profile. `write` adds metadata-only mutations on owned routes and on user preferences.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 expiry. When omitted the token does not expire and lives until the user revokes it.

id.description: Stable identifier used to revoke the token.

lastUsedAt.description: Most recent time the token was used to authenticate a request, or null if never used since creation.

expiresAt.description: Expiry timestamp, or null if the token has no expiry.

token.description: The plaintext bearer token. Returned exactly once at creation time; the API does not store it and there is no way to retrieve it later. If you lose it, revoke the token and mint a new one.

id.description: Stable identifier used to revoke the token.

lastUsedAt.description: Most recent time the token was used to authenticate a request, or null if never used since creation.

expiresAt.description: Expiry timestamp, or null if the token has no expiry.

costing.description: Costing model used by Valhalla to match the shape to edges.

shape.description: Recorded shape points to match against the road network. Capped at 1500 points.

surface.description: OSM surface classification for the edge.

begin_shape_index.description: Index of the first shape point covered by this edge.

end_shape_index.description: Index of the last shape point covered by this edge.

shape.description: Polyline6-encoded matched shape returned by Valhalla.

activity.description: Activity that determines the Valhalla costing model (bicycle vs pedestrian).

preferences.description: Routes preferences inputs that shape the route. Translated to Valhalla costing server-side.

locations.description: Locations to route through, in order. Capped at 25.

walkingSpeedKmh.description: Walking speed in kilometers per hour. Only applied to pedestrian routing.

original_index.description: Index of the originally-supplied location, when Valhalla returns it.

start.description: Loop start point; the generated route begins and ends here.

heading.description: Compass arc the loop should extend toward. A soft preference, never a hard guarantee.

excludeBearings.description: Fan bearings already shown to the user; regenerate passes them to get fresh shapes.

bearingDeg.description: Fan bearing that produced this candidate, in degrees.

viaPoints.description: Snapped via points in loop order (excluding the start). Confirming the candidate turns start + vias + start into the draft's Waypoints.

shape.description: Polyline6-encoded RoutePath of the full loop.

overlapPct.description: Overlap: % of distance traversing the same way more than once (0..100).

score.description: Weighted candidate score, 0..1, higher is better.

lowQuality.description: True when the candidate is shown with a quality badge (elevated Overlap).

surfaceMetersByBucket.description: Surface composition of the loop in meters per SurfaceBucket.

bestOverlapPct.description: Best Overlap % among rejected candidates; explains an all_candidates_low_quality failure.

candidates.description: Up to 3 diverse GenerationCandidates, best score first. Empty when generation failed.

failure.description: Set when no usable candidate could be produced; the code drives retry suggestions in the UI.
